# Social images

## Generated by Next.js (canonical for the site)

| Route | Size | Use |
|-------|------|-----|
| `/opengraph-image` | 1200×630 | Open Graph / Meta / Instagram link shares |
| `/twitter-image` | 1200×630 | Twitter / X `summary_large_image` |

These are rendered from the landing hero composition (Yuse mark + Why headline only). No nav CTAs.

## Static repo assets

| File | Use |
|------|-----|
| `github-cover.png` | GitHub repo social preview. Upload at GitHub repo **Settings → Social preview**. |

`og-homepage.png` is legacy. Prefer the generated `/opengraph-image` route for the website.
